title: Why Preparing for a Market Crash Is Killing Your Returns
text: So, the way to think about being able to exist and survive is you can't base everything off of these crash potentials. A lot of it again is very specific to the strategy and the way that it behaves. Because if you size your option positions off of the worst case scenario in every single one of them, you'll never put any risk on. You have to have a probabilistic understanding of the thing that you're trading and what it's likely to do.
